Shared rules for gate queues
The purpose of this section is to describe how the desk handles it

The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps gate queues calm, clear, and fair for every traveler with an animal. Staff greet people in a steady tone, check the care notes, and guide each case with the same patient attention. <<FACT F012>> If the passenger needs extra support, the desk stays close, explains the next step in simple words, and avoids crowding the animal. Care plans should reflect the species, temperament, and comfort needs that have been shared ahead of travel, with the welcome team ready to adjust the flow when a pet is anxious. <<FACT F024>> When a traveler arrives with documents, the desk confirms them, keeps the line moving, and asks the supervisor to help if a case feels unusual. The goal is always to protect safety, reduce stress, and keep the boarding handoff smooth for both people and pets. For questions or concerns, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
